title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New School〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku, everyone.
Thank you for watching our practice this late again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See you tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The girls' practice went really well today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They were well and truly focused, and they made very few mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I guess it's because they're second-years now?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure that played a role, but don't you think it's mostly because they're signed to a label now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seems they're well underway preparing to make their debut.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm very excited for that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want everyone to hear them play their songs.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then they'll all fall in love with their music and—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I thought I'd find you here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Sorry to interrupt your thoughts.
Something about the way you were acting earlier was weighing on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, what's bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've been taking it for granted that the girls' music will be this widespread overnight success...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I'd be so happy if that happened...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But the reality is, actually being a professional has got to be even harder than becoming one, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I realized that, if that's the case, I need to snap out of all my optimistic daydreams.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I came here to cool off.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're always such a dependable senior, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm always trying my best to be one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder just how far the girls will go.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How far do you want them to go?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
As far as they can, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want them to soar into the distance like four shining shooting stars.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If they're taking off with that much force, we need to make sure we're not left behind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's keep it up watching over our girls.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll all keep watching over their path ahead, together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.
